MODAL.TITLE: Whatsapp Templates
MODAL.SUBTITLE: Select the whatsapp template you want to send

PICKER.NO_FAVORITES: No favorites yet. Star templates you use often for quick access.
PICKER.NO_TEMPLATES_AVAILABLE: No WhatsApp templates available. Click refresh to sync templates from WhatsApp.
PICKER.REFRESH_SUCCESS: Templates refresh initiated. It may take a couple of minutes to update.
PICKER.REFRESH_ERROR: Failed to refresh templates. Please try again.

PARSER.FORM_ERROR_MESSAGE: Please fill all variables before sending

CREATOR.TITLE: Create Template
CREATOR.SUBTITLE: Create a new WhatsApp template for Meta approval
CREATOR.NAME_HINT: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only
CREATOR.BODY_PLACEHOLDER: Enter the message body. Use {'{{'}variable{'}}'} for dynamic content.
CREATOR.SUCCESS: Template submitted for Meta approval. Status: PENDING. It will appear in the templates list after approval and sync.

VALIDATION.NAME_FORMAT: Only lowercase letters, numbers and underscores allowed, must start with a letter
VALIDATION.BODY_MAX: Body text must be under 1024 characters
VALIDATION.BUTTON_MAX: Button text must be under 25 characters

INTERACTIVE.TITLE: Create Interactive Message
INTERACTIVE.SUBTITLE: Reusable templates with CTA button, link in body or quick replies
INTERACTIVE.TYPE_CTA_HINT: A blue button with a URL. Up to 3 buttons total (CTA + 2 quick replies).
INTERACTIVE.TYPE_BODY_LINK_HINT: The link goes inside the body text (opens in external browser). Useful when OTP must be resolved.
INTERACTIVE.TYPE_QUICK_REPLIES_HINT: Quick reply buttons only (up to 3). No URL.
INTERACTIVE.BODY_PLACEHOLDER: Tell the contact why they should tap the button.
INTERACTIVE.URL_MODE_DYNAMIC_HINT: Replaced at send time by the generated checkout link.
INTERACTIVE.URL_MODE_STATIC_HINT: Use any public URL (e.g., website, landing page, form).
INTERACTIVE.QUICK_REPLIES_HINT_WITH_CTA: Up to 2 when a CTA button exists (3 total).
INTERACTIVE.IMAGE_HINT: The image is copied to the public Socialwise bucket before sending to WhatsApp.
INTERACTIVE.IMAGE_ERROR: Failed to publish the header image.
INTERACTIVE.ERROR: Failed to save the interactive message.
INTERACTIVE.DELETE_ERROR: Failed to remove the interactive message.
INTERACTIVE.SEND_ERROR: Failed to send the interactive message.
INTERACTIVE.SEND_NO_CONVERSATION: Open a conversation before sending the message.

VALIDATION.BODY_MAX: Body text must be under 1024 characters
VALIDATION.HEADER_MAX: Header text must be under 60 characters
VALIDATION.FOOTER_MAX: Footer text must be under 60 characters
VALIDATION.BUTTON_MAX: CTA button text must be under 20 characters
VALIDATION.URL_INVALID: Enter a valid URL (http or https)
VALIDATION.QUICK_REPLY_MAX: Quick reply text must be under 20 characters
VALIDATION.QUICK_REPLY_LIMIT_WITH_CTA: Maximum 2 quick replies when a CTA button is present
VALIDATION.QUICK_REPLIES_AT_LEAST_ONE: Add at least one quick reply
